chars.SON: SON: a young Moroccan man in his late twenties, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers, white sneakers.
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan man around sixty, bald on top with grey hair on the sides and a thick grey moustache, wearing a navy-blue knitted cardigan over a white collared shirt and beige trousers.
chars.WOMAN: WOMAN: a Moroccan woman in her late twenties, long wavy dark brown hair, gold hoop earrings, wearing a red satin blouse and black trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a modest Moroccan apartment living room with a low sofa and patterned cushions. DAD sits forward on the sofa, leaning toward SON, raising one finger, very serious face, telling him something important. SON sits beside him, frozen, eyes wide in shock.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. Close medium shot: DAD shakes his head firmly with a stern, protective look, one hand on SON's shoulder. SON looks down, confused and hurt.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Flashback at night in a dim lounge café with warm orange lights in a Moroccan city. WOMAN stands behind the counter serving drinks with a flirty smile to customers. In the foreground DAD sits at a small table, recognizing her, raising his eyebrows in surprise.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SON alone in his bedroom at night, sitting on the edge of his bed, both hands on his head, mouth open, realizing a shocking truth. Soft blue light from the window.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Late at night, SON lies in bed in a dark Moroccan bedroom, his face lit by his smartphone screen, reading a message with a suspicious, cold frown.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Morning in a small Moroccan kitchen with mint tea glasses on the table. DAD nods slowly with a sad, knowing look, confirming. SON stands across the table, jaw tight, listening.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: SON standing on a Moroccan apartment balcony in daylight, determined face, pressing his thumb on his phone screen as if blocking a contact, other hand clenched into a fist.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SON on a phone call on a quiet Moroccan street with white buildings, calm but cold expression, waving his free hand as if saying goodbye, walking away.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SON sits alone on a Moroccan rooftop at sunset with satellite dishes and laundry lines around, looking at the horizon, sad but relieved, a small bitter smile.
